title: Friendship and Social Pressure: The Compass of Values
summary: At the age of 7-9, friends become more influential. Teach your child: the righteous friend reminds him of Allah, and pressure to do wrong is not friendship. Build his self-confidence so he becomes a leader, not a follower.
try_this: Ask him: "If a friend asked you to do something you know is wrong, what would you do?" — discuss the scenarios (cheating, bullying, breaking a rule).
reflection_prompts: Does he have a friend who encourages him toward goodness?
